description:
What moved for a site: first its weekly briefing, if any (this week's moves and up to 5 priced fixes); then, since the previous check, per buyer question and engine, where the brand gained or lost a citation (its URL among the sources), with the domains cited instead and competitors named for a lost one; plus tracked keywords that moved in Google. Compares the newest completed audit with the newest earlier one on the same questions.

Billing: free — reads stored results; works at a zero balance.

When to call: at the start of a session about a site, when the user asks what changed, or after a monitor run.

Inputs: site_id — from list_sites; or domain instead. audit_id (optional) — compare this audit with the one before it instead of the newest (e.g. when the newest is a one-question spot check).

Returns { briefing: {briefing_id, week_of, headline, stats: [{label, value, delta_label, period}], summary, findings, offers: [suggested_next shape + offer_id], dashboard_url} | null, site_id, domain, headline, citations: { current: {audit_id, ran_at, cited, mentioned, answered, url}, previous | null, compared_cells (cells both audits answered), cited_before, cited_after, gained: [{prompt, engine, brand_url}], lost: [{prompt, engine, cited_instead, competitors_named}], mention_gained, mention_lost, new_cells } | null, keywords: { tracked, up, down, unchanged, dropped_out, entered, not_ranked, first_check, moved: [{keyword, position, previous_position, change, url, checked_at}] } | null (each keyword in one count), monitor: {monitor_id, status, cadence, next_run_at} | null, crawl: {run_id, completed_at, site_health, health_delta, new_errors, fixed_errors, top_new_errors} | null, next_step, suggested_next? }. crawl: the latest scored Site Audit crawl vs the one before. suggested_next: the briefing's top fix, else monitor_citations for an unmonitored site. headline: one line to relay; lists cap at 25. Relay the briefing's fixes with prices; run one only if the user agrees.

Example: { domain: "acme.com" }

audit_id.description: Optional: the audit to treat as current (one of the site's 25 newest completed audits). Default: the newest.

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "acme.com" — instead of site_id.

name: get_changes
title: What changed since last time: weekly briefing, citations and Google ranks
